## X-Sense Home Security v1.6.7-8

- Reduced redundant MQTT state writes for station-only Wi-Fi signal reports and repeated SBS50 connection notices that do not change connectivity. Removed detailed per-sensor timing and avoided building debug metadata when debug logging is off. Aggregate MQTT diagnostics remain available. This reduces dispatch overhead but does not establish that the reported long stall is resolved (#447).
- Select house-state shadows based on the discovered Wi-Fi models, following the X-Sense app. Second-generation-only houses no longer request the legacy shadow first, where a 403 could prevent setup before the required shadow was read. Mixed houses still request both shadows when needed (#462).
